description: Chiffres clés enquête 2024 Plan Hérault Vélo is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. Infographie des résultats des enquêtes réalisées dans le cadre du Plan Hérault Vélo. Coverage: Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. The publisher named on the listing is Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. Its keywords include enquete, velo, routes-transports-et-mobilites, mobilite. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2025-02-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
